en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from an elevated vantage point over a small European town in a narrow valley. A straight main street runs through the center, lined with 2‑ to 3‑story masonry houses with steep, tiled gable roofs. On the left stands a larger institutional-looking building with a tower-like projection and hipped roof, surrounded by trees; behind it and on the hillsides are more villas and houses. Forested hills enclose the town on both sides. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart are visible on the street, and there appears to be a trench or canal beside the road. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
